subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway 40B Application
overview: The board continued its comprehensive permit review for 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway, hearing detailed design and landscaping presentations from the applicant's team and initial peer review findings from Tetra Tech. The hearing was continued to February 27, 2023.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway (40B-2022-01)
items.summary: Continued the comprehensive permit hearing to February 27, 2023, following presentations on building massing, courtyards, and civil peer review comments covering construction staging and site utilities.
